Preserve Heilprin’s disagreement. Peah’s oath lacks לא, Sotah’s includes it, and Heilprin’s Avahu article gives the affirmative formula as Avahu’s own rejoinder.
Parallel Sotah textual form has אם לא שמעתי, whereas Peah has אם שמעתיה. Preserve printed Heilprin denial and flag wording divergence.
Peah and Sotah textual forms diverge on the oath; preserve the printed denial and corroborating Peah.
